body.message:
Thank you for clarifying. I’d like to proceed with locking in the rates for the 3 months (6000/6500/7500), as this gives both sides more certainty.

However, could you confirm the timing for the 50% advance payment of the last month’s rent? I’d like to pay the July rent (6000 AED) now, and pay the 50% advance for September (3750 AED) closer to that date — for example, at the mid of August — rather than all at once today. This would still allow you to guarantee the rate for all 3 months while giving me more flexibility on cash flow.

Please confirm if this arrangement works.
